svg.title: Rock Saw Water Control — complete single-page Revision D schematic
svg.desc: Six circuit sections, every external connection, every component, internal common connections and unused terminals. Bench design with release holds H1–H5.
svg.text: ROCK-SAW WATER CONTROL / COMPLETE SINGLE-PAGE SCHEMATIC
Revision D • compiled 7 October 2026 • A0 landscape • six circuit sections + all 126 external connections
Functional terminal labels; X1 numbers are NOT machine connector cavities.

Pin names are functional labels, not footprints. Repeated distribution points mean joined bus terminals. Route lamp/valve returns separately from logic/ADC returns.
H1 actual machine cavities; H2 existing fuse / wire ratings; H3 purchased parts; H4 valve signal common / compliance; H5 firmware and bench qualification.
